scope: Actual REST adapter and guard with mocked fetch. No account/credentials connected; Lua was inspected but not executed on a live Redis.
results: REST destination validation prevents unexpected hosts, credentials and redirects
One EVAL atomically reserves call, bytes, output and shared window
Provider quota/error is fail-closed and does not leak raw body
Missing credentials cause no network request
Gemini is called only after confirmed remote reservation
Remote global stop blocks Gemini; short denial cache reduces free commands
Environment global stop blocks before Redis and before operation
Missing key cannot initialize/reset/enable itself; persistent state has no TTL
